crossRefs.note: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written…
(and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Suphah
people.line: Place mentioned in the Book of the Wars of the Lord

people.name: Waheb
people.line: A place mentioned in the Book of Numbers

translations.web: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
translations.bsb: Therefore it is stated in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: “Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of the Arnon,
translations.kjv: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
translations.asv: Wherefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, And the valleys of the Arnon,
